nodes.label: .github/workflows/ci.yml badge and workflow link
nodes.rationale: The English README links the workflow and its CI badge; this is a README citation, not a definition of the workflow source.

nodes.label: memory/recall.py (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Absolute-path Python invocation with --query and --ledger searches inbox and full curated text including unindexed files. Additional queries express synonyms/languages; agent judges context. PARTIAL signals read/budget failures, no-match has no unrelated fallback and no-Python uses direct file search.

nodes.label: install-companions.sh (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Step 4/5 installs superpowers, RTK and Graphify. --skip-companions skips all, --no-superpowers skips the plugin, --keep-superpowers is a compatibility no-op. Working tools are reused and OK/SKIP/FAIL/INCOMPLETE distinguish partial wiring without aborting Conductor.

nodes.label: tools/restore-memory.py (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Preserves committed history, lessons, archives, language and backup script; project restoration requires a separate command. Nonempty destinations are refused and cloning excludes uncommitted source data.

nodes.label: uninstall.sh (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Preview with --dry-run, preserve inbox/curated lessons to Desktop using --keep-lessons, and sweep legacy adapters/git locks under explicit --sweep-roots. Backups and foreign hooks survive; global CLAUDE.md and companions are preserved.

nodes.label: memory/migrate-lessons.sh
nodes.rationale: Installed beside runtime so lesson maintenance works without a source checkout; the distillation playbook remains the procedure.

nodes.label: memory/recall.md
nodes.rationale: Task-based retrieval guide; startup supplies locations, memory contents and maintenance policy stay unchanged, and unchanged retrieval need not repeat every message.

nodes.label: playbooks/distill.md
nodes.rationale: Existing lesson-maintenance procedure applies to the installed migration tool without requiring a checkout.

nodes.label: Conductor README
nodes.rationale: Overview, operational requirements, installation, verification evidence, language, memory recovery, removal and source layout.

nodes.label: install.ps1 PowerShell bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Downloads and executes official bootstrap source without a repository clone; prerequisites and execution policy are not silently changed, and language can be explicit.

nodes.label: bootstrap.sh Bash bootstrap
nodes.rationale: The documented pipefail/curl pipeline downloads official source to temporary storage; users may inspect the downloaded script first.

nodes.label: install.sh unified global installer
nodes.rationale: Default all installs Claude Code and global adapters with companions; --scope selects claude/global/all. install-global.sh is internal compatibility, while Cursor activation remains manual.

nodes.label: Lessons inbox (~/.claude/conductor/lessons.md)
nodes.rationale: One line per captured lesson, shared by the agents on the machine.

nodes.label: Curated lessons (~/.claude/conductor/lessons/)
nodes.rationale: One file per digested lesson plus an index; matching text must be read in context.

nodes.label: conductor CLI: status, update and rollback
nodes.norm_label: conductor cli: status, update and rollback
nodes.rationale: Installed in ~/.local/bin with conductor.cmd on Windows; fetches official main into a separate temporary directory, supports --check and --ref, and only updates registered components while preserving language and memory.

nodes.label: Graphify codebase knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Installs PyPI graphifyy in existing uv or isolated Python venv without system pip changes. Claude skill is connected; Codex skill installation is a separate printed command.

nodes.label: Installation snapshots and ownership checks
nodes.rationale: Initial replacement warns and backs up; installs/<id> snapshots support manual recovery, not CLI rollback. Manual edits block reinstall, memory survives and ordinary installation must not run concurrently.

nodes.label: Answer in Russian substitution token
nodes.rationale: Repository masters must retain the substitution phrase guarded by lint; changing it breaks --language matching. Language overrides belong to installed/project-local settings.

nodes.label: Two-stage lesson memory
nodes.rationale: Every AI can cheaply append one line to the inbox; separate per-lesson files and an index support task-based contextual retrieval, with recency only breaking relevance ties.

nodes.label: Private memory transfer to another machine
nodes.norm_label: private memory transfer to another machine
nodes.rationale: Restore the entire separate private repository into a new/empty directory before installing Conductor; project snapshots and Windows scheduling are explicit separate actions, and --keep-lessons is not a full repository backup.

nodes.label: Project-local language overrides
nodes.rationale: A project CLAUDE.md has its own immediately read language line; install-project.sh --repo ... --language overrides only that project's adapters and leaves the machine choice intact.

nodes.label: Persisted reply language
nodes.rationale: Installer menus default to the prior choice in ~/.claude/conductor/reply-language, and --language supports noninteractive use. English instructions avoid unwanted Russian reasoning; replies and visible reasoning follow the chosen language via an explicit rule.

nodes.label: Installation prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Requires Bash, Git and Python 3.10+; Windows uses Git for Windows/Git Bash from ordinary PowerShell. CI covers Windows/Linux; macOS is not separately verified. Claude Code is installed/authenticated and other IDE adapters are optional.

nodes.label: RTK terminal-output compression
nodes.rationale: Downloads an official release binary verified by SHA-256 without Rust/Cargo; rtk init -g --auto-patch wires the Claude hook, RTK.md and its import.

nodes.label: superpowers workflow-skills plugin
nodes.rationale: Official Claude plugin marketplace is preferred with obra/superpowers-marketplace fallback; the plugin is now installed because Conductor supplies discipline and superpowers supplies workflow skills.

nodes.label: Update backups and conditional rollback
nodes.rationale: updates/ backups precede writes and failed checks restore files; later edits stop rollback. Backups survive uninstall, may contain private rules and are not auto-deleted. Concurrent update/rollback is locked and ordinary installation must stay separate.

nodes.label: docs/memory-recovery.md
nodes.rationale: Linked recovery guide gives the complete-memory restore order and commands.

nodes.label: conductor/evidence/cli.py
nodes.rationale: Optional explicit run/list/show/check stores real executions, full output and declared input snapshots, with separate histories for projects, clones and worktrees; it neither reuses the activity journal nor skips tests automatically.

nodes.label: verification.json execution specification
nodes.rationale: Schema version 1 declares argv, cwd, inputs, environment, external_state and timeout. The example runs check.py with src/check.py inputs, no declared environment keys, none_declared external state and a 60-second timeout.

nodes.label: Commit discipline
nodes.rationale: Inspect impact, reuse only applicable inspected proof and match it to staged content. Full suites/builds need impact or an explicit project requirement; CI requirements remain in force and release builds are a separate delivery step.

nodes.label: Conductor discipline system
nodes.rationale: The README describes task classification, proof before completion and commits, and task-relevant reuse of persisted lessons across Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity and Codex.

nodes.label: MATCH applicability boundary
nodes.rationale: run always executes; show exposes metadata/full-output paths; check never runs a test. MATCH means observed conditions agree, while the agent must inspect coverage and output; unknown external state, links, unreadable inputs or lost environment key prevent reuse.

nodes.label: Local verification evidence storage
nodes.rationale: Stored outside projects in LOCALAPPDATA/Conductor/evidence on Windows or XDG_STATE_HOME/conductor/evidence elsewhere, with absolute CONDUCTOR_EVIDENCE_HOME override. No upload/pruning, history survives reinstall/removal, secret output requires care, and 64 MiB truncation or corruption invalidates reuse.

nodes.label: Removed marker git gate
nodes.rationale: The textual proof rule remains after removal of the extra marker-file lock, which added no evidence and could break commits; installers clean its leftovers.

nodes.label: Methodology: core, playbooks and method dispatcher
nodes.norm_label: methodology: core, playbooks and method dispatcher
nodes.rationale: Core iron laws and a predicted-outcome completion gate work with debugging, investigation, implementation, orchestration, skeptic and distillation playbooks; task essence selects the method.

nodes.label: Proportional verification
nodes.rationale: Inspection suffices for simple displayed wording; behavior changes require affected scenarios and applicable previous results can be reused.

nodes.label: Repository structure and source of truth
nodes.norm_label: repository structure and source of truth
nodes.rationale: runtime holds core/playbooks/contract/hooks, adapters contains the shared body and generated digests, deploy holds global CLAUDE, tools handles maintenance, qa holds lint/tests/reports and docs holds design history.

nodes.label: Digest build, lint and install cycle
nodes.norm_label: digest build, lint and install cycle
nodes.rationale: Changes originate in runtime/ and adapters/core-body.md, followed by tools/build-digests.sh, qa/lint.sh and installation; live copies are built from repository source.

nodes.label: qa/reports/ab-report-v2.md
nodes.rationale: August repetition used the full shipped English file: 27/27 at n=5 in both arms, reproduce-first in 12/12 debug repeats, +2 median turns. Long sessions, RTK/style/Graphify and the untriggered three-attempt breaker remain outside that evidence.

nodes.label: qa/reports/baseline.md
nodes.rationale: The first control arm passed 13 discipline trials with the values file still installed; the README explicitly rejects interpreting this as a bare-model result.

nodes.label: qa/reports/baseline-values-file.md
nodes.rationale: Preserves the 56-line trimmed Russian values-file conditions of the July measurement.

nodes.label: Mandatory global values file
nodes.rationale: The documented discipline results depend on deploy/global-CLAUDE.md installed as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. Removing both duplicated rules and this file would invalidate that condition; uninstall preserves it.

nodes.label: tools/schedule-memory-backup.ps1 (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Restores Windows scheduling separately, supports preview and never replaces an existing task.

nodes.label: Safe Graphify map update
nodes.rationale: Repository maintenance uses uv run --with graphifyy==0.9.67 python tools/graphify-update.py --root . from the repository root. Requires uv and Python 3.10+, or a Python 3.10+ environment already containing graphifyy==0.9.67. This updates the local map, separately from conductor update for installed rules.

nodes.label: Full local code AST extraction
nodes.rationale: For code-only changes the updater rebuilds the syntax tree for the entire code corpus locally without invoking a model.

nodes.label: NEEDS_SEMANTIC request
nodes.rationale: Changed documents require semantic extraction. The entrypoint returns NEEDS_SEMANTIC, exit code 3 and a request-file path without changing published map files.

nodes.label: Host-agent source reconciliation
nodes.rationale: The host agent using the Graphify skill reads the requested source files and prior graph, reconciles original IDs, edges and hyperedges, and grounds removal reasons in source text. It reruns the same entrypoint with --semantic FILE --review FILE; inputs stay outside the analyzed corpus or under graphify-out/.conductor/.

nodes.label: Mandatory identity and relationship guards
nodes.rationale: The same entrypoint applies mandatory checks to source-bound reconciliation of previous IDs, edges and hyperedges before publishing the replacement. These protections are part of the maintenance command.

nodes.label: Semantic completeness review
nodes.rationale: Mechanical guards cannot automatically prove complete semantic extraction; the host agent must assess source meaning and justified removals.

nodes.label: Source- and prompt-attributed semantic cache
nodes.rationale: Optional --prompt-file FILE supplies the actual extraction prompt and enables semantic caching attributed to both source files and that prompt.

nodes.label: Isolated graph staging and backups
nodes.rationale: Build results separately and keep backups and intermediate files under graphify-out/.conductor/, not intended for Git. The previous map is retained until successful publication.

nodes.label: Source stability checks
nodes.rationale: The entrypoint checks that sources have not changed while the replacement is prepared and published.

nodes.label: Operating-system update lock
nodes.rationale: The updater uses an operating-system lock to prevent concurrent entrypoint invocations from writing the map together.

nodes.label: Graph publication rollback and interruption recovery
nodes.rationale: Failure triggers rollback; after a hard interruption the next invocation recovers the unfinished publication.

nodes.label: Foreign-edit protection during recovery
nodes.rationale: Later foreign edits that conflict with recovery stop it while preserving data, so recovery cannot silently erase subsequent work.

nodes.label: No force bypass
nodes.rationale: There is no force option for bypassing the safe-update protections.

nodes.label: Graph-last publication boundary
nodes.rationale: The old map remains until successful publication, with graph.json replaced last. The files do not all switch atomically and readers are not locked.

nodes.label: Raw Graphify writer exclusion
nodes.rationale: Do not run raw Graphify map-writing commands concurrently with the safe entrypoint; the documented OS lock does not justify mixing independent writers.

nodes.label: tools/graphify-update.py (reference in README.en.md)
nodes.rationale: Documented repository-local safe map maintenance entrypoint; this reference retains its document context instead of pretending to define a Python symbol.
